title: Verify: Store focus focuses the matching scene object unit tests
summary: Unit test that a store focus value focuses the matching object
description: Write a Phaser-mocked unit test proving REQ-1.
acceptance_criteria: Setting focusedObjectId 'bookshelf' calls focus() on the bookshelf fake only
The 'bed' fake's focus() is not called when focusedObjectId is 'bookshelf'
technical_constraints: Mock phaser, ../src/runtime/content, @game/engine/buildScene, buildEffects, playSceneTransition, phaser renderContext and effectContext the same way tests/bootSceneKeyboard.test.ts does

steps.symbol: new: describe('BootScene store focus') it('focuses the object matching focusedObjectId')
steps.action: Copy the vi.mock block and BootScene create() setup from tests/bootSceneKeyboard.test.ts. Build two fake objects {spec:{id:'bookshelf'}, isFocused:false, focus, blur, sync, destroy, onInteract, handleKey} and {spec:{id:'bed'}, ...}. Return both from the mocked buildScene, call create(), then call useGameStore.getState().setFocusedObject('bookshelf'). Assert bookshelf.focus toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1) and bed.focus not.toHaveBeenCalled().
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneFocus.test.ts -t 'focuses the object matching'
steps.expected: Test passes: only the bookshelf fake is focused
